summary: Skycorp Solar Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) to be held on June 10, 2026. The filing includes an EGM notice, press release, and form of proxy. No specific special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, going-private, restructuring) is described. The EGM is a routine shareholder meeting with no disclosed agenda items beyond standard corporate matters. Under SEC rules for foreign private issuers, this is a routine current report. There are no deal terms, price, premium, break fee, or advisor names mentioned. The filing does not involve a forced management change, activist campaign, or strategic review. As a simple meeting notice with no transformative event, it falls outside special-situations classification.
